title: Meta Ads For Local Businesses: Complete Guide 2026

facts.fact: The guide says urban local businesses typically perform best with a 5-10 mile radius around their location in Meta Ads targeting.
facts.quote: Urban businesses typically perform best with 5-10 mile radius.

facts.fact: The guide says suburban local businesses often need a 10-15 mile targeting radius in Meta Ads.
facts.quote: Suburban businesses often need 10-15 miles.

facts.fact: The guide says rural service businesses might extend their Meta Ads targeting radius to 25-50 miles, depending on how far customers will travel.
facts.quote: Rural service businesses might extend to 25-50 miles depending on how far customers will travel for your service.

facts.fact: The guide's example for a trendy bar suggests targeting people aged 21-35 rather than all adults.
facts.quote: A trendy bar targeting 21-35 year olds will perform better than one targeting all adults.

facts.fact: The guide's example for a retirement planning service suggests focusing ad targeting on people aged 50-65.
facts.quote: A retirement planning service should focus on 50-65 year olds.

facts.fact: The guide's example for a coffee shop describes reaching people within a 5-mile radius who love specialty coffee.
facts.quote: A coffee shop can reach people within a 5-mile radius who love specialty coffee.

facts.fact: The guide recommends starting local Meta campaigns with a daily budget of $10-30 to gather initial performance data.
facts.quote: Start with a daily budget of $10-30 to gather initial performance data in your area.

facts.fact: The guide states that a $15 daily budget over one week ($105 total) typically generates enough data to identify patterns and make optimization decisions.
facts.quote: A $15 daily budget over a week ($105 total) typically generates enough data to identify patterns and make optimization decisions.

facts.fact: The guide advises running automatic bidding for 7-10 days before switching to cost cap bidding.
facts.quote: After you've run for 7-10 days and understand your cost per result, switch to cost cap bidding.

facts.fact: The guide gives an example of setting a cost cap at $10 when average cost per lead is $8, i.e., slightly above the current average.
facts.quote: If you're averaging $8 per lead, set a cost cap at $10 to give the algorithm flexibility while preventing runaway costs.

facts.fact: The guide suggests a lunch restaurant concentrate ad budget between 10am and 1pm.
facts.quote: A lunch restaurant should concentrate budget between 10am-1pm when people are deciding where to eat.

facts.fact: The guide suggests a bar focus ad spend from 4pm to 10pm, Thursday through Saturday.
facts.quote: A bar should focus on 4pm-10pm Thursday through Saturday.

facts.fact: The guide recommends splitting a $30/day budget into three ad sets at $10/day each to test different local audience segments.
facts.quote: Instead of putting $30/day into one ad set, split it into three ad sets at $10/day each

facts.fact: The guide recommends increasing the budget of a winning ad set by 20-30% every 3-4 days rather than doubling it overnight.
facts.quote: increase its budget by 20-30% every 3-4 days rather than doubling it overnight.

facts.fact: The guide recommends creating 3-5 different images or videos, each emphasizing a different aspect of the business, for testing.
facts.quote: Create 3-5 different images or videos, each emphasizing different aspects of your business.

facts.fact: The guide recommends updating local ad creative monthly because creative fatigue happens faster in smaller geographic areas.
facts.quote: Keep your creative fresh by updating it monthly.

facts.fact: The guide recommends making first data-driven campaign adjustments after 3-5 days of campaign data.
facts.quote: Make data-driven adjustments after the first 3-5 days of campaign data.

facts.fact: The guide suggests pausing ad sets whose cost per result is 50% or more above target.
facts.quote: Pause ad sets with cost per result 50%+ above your target.

facts.fact: The guide suggests increasing budget on ad sets performing 20% or more better than average.
facts.quote: Increase budget on ad sets performing 20%+ better than average.

facts.fact: The guide recommends creating a 1% lookalike audience limited to the business's geographic area, built from local converters.
facts.quote: create a 1% lookalike audience limited to your geographic area.

facts.fact: The guide recommends refreshing lookalike audiences quarterly as the customer list grows.
facts.quote: refresh your lookalike audiences quarterly to keep them current.

facts.fact: The guide recommends building retargeting audiences from people who engaged with the business in the past 30 days.
facts.quote: engaged with your Page or Instagram profile in the past 30 days.

facts.fact: The guide recommends dedicating 20% of a local Meta Ads budget to testing new creative, audiences, or offers while the other 80% runs proven winners.
facts.quote: Dedicate 20% of your budget to testing new creative, audiences, or offers while the other 80% runs proven winners.

facts.fact: The guide advises testing one variable at a time so that performance changes can be clearly attributed.
facts.quote: Test one variable at a time so you can clearly attribute performance changes.
